$meta.source: Extracted from hifi-primitives.jsx (hfTokens) + measured usage across v3. Mobile frame 390×844.
$meta.note: Platform-neutral. Colors resolved to concrete rgba/hex — no CSS color-mix/oklab (Flutter can't consume those). accentSoft is the accent pre-blended onto transparent at the documented alpha.

flutterMapping.colors: ColorScheme + a custom ThemeExtension for the non-Material roles (ink2, inkMute, inkFaint, fill, fillStrong, line, success, spotify, accentSoft).
flutterMapping.type: TextTheme — sizes are logical px == Flutter logical pixels 1:1.
flutterMapping.opacityInks: ink/ink2/inkMute/inkFaint are one base color at descending alpha. In Flutter use baseColor.withOpacity(a) rather than 4 separate hex values.

accents._doc: Default accent is teal. User-selectable. light/dark are the resolved swatch; soft is the same hue at low alpha used for badges/pills.

_roles.spotify: Spotify Connect brand dot — branded exception, do not reuse

type._familyNote: Geist is open-source (geist-font / Vercel). Bundle the TTFs in the Flutter app; do not rely on a system fallback for brand consistency.
type._desktopNote: Tablet/desktop layouts scale the display sizes up (NowPlaying title 34→38). Mobile values above are canonical for the Flutter phone build.

space._doc: De-facto scale measured from gaps/padding. Mostly even; codified here so Flutter uses named steps, not literals.

radius._doc: Cards 16, primary buttons 12, inputs/segmented 9, small chips 6–7, album art 10, fully-round controls use pill.

elevation._doc: Bottom strip / floating group bar uses float–floatLg. Flat cards use the hairline border, not shadow.

touch._doc: Every interactive control has a >=44px tap area (transparent hit-slop is fine — the visible glyph can be smaller, e.g. 34px circle inside a 44px button).

icons._doc: Custom inline-SVG set on a 24×24 viewBox, 1.7 default stroke (filled glyphs noted). Rebuild as a Flutter icon font or SVG assets. Standard glyphs can map to Material/Lucide; the device + brand glyphs below are custom and must be reproduced.
icons._customNote: speaker/speakers/soundbar are the room-type glyphs; oto-mark is the brand mark (see brand/ SVGs).
